FORMAT INSTRUCTIONS:
- Return the conclusion logic statement, as your final answer.
- Use the following notation to denote symbols
    - OR = ∨
    - AND = ∧
    - IMPLIES = →
    - IFF = ↔
    - NOT = ¬

.5. ¬(¬(Y ∨ T) ∨ ¬(P ∨ P))

.7. (((¬X → (R ∨ W)) ↔ ((P ∨ T) ↔ (U ∨ X))) ∨ ¬((U ∨ X) ∧ (Q ∨ Y)))
.8. ((((V → R) ↔ (P ∧ R)) ↔ (¬V ↔ (U → S))) → (((U ↔ X) ↔ (T ∨ Y)) ∨ ((R ∨ X) ∨ (Q ∧ P))))
.9. (((¬V → (T ↔ R)) ↔ ((P ↔ U) → (Y ∨ Y))) → (((V ↔ R) ∨ (V ∧ S)) ↔ ((T ↔ X) ∧ (S ∧ W))))
.10. ((((R ↔ U) ↔ (W → R)) ↔ (¬X → (U ∨ U))) ↔ (¬¬R ∧ ((T ∨ X) ∨ (R ↔ P))))
.What can we conclude from the above statements?
